blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The tropical storm spotted east of Northern Luzon is expected to enter the Philippine area of responsibility (PAR) on Thursday morning, according to the state weather bureau. In its morning forecast, the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical, and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa) said the tropical storm with an international name “Surigae” was last located 1,500 kilometers east of Northern Luzon. It is moving west-northeastward at 30 kilometers per hour (kph).
